title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1970 show with a smoking Lovelight, epic Spanish Jam and a laid‑back Dark Star captured on a classic soundboard recording (a bit tinny but still enjoyable).
ai_review.review: The performance is celebrated for its guest‑filled second set – Greg Allman and Pigpen sharing vocals on an electrifying Lovelight, plus one of the best Spanish Jams ever heard, and a long, mellow Dark Star that many reviewers call essential. The source is a vintage soundboard (SBD) which most listeners describe as crisp and classic, though a few note a tinny/harsh edge that could use EQ. Overall the musical highs far outweigh any minor recording quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive comments about the performance (standout songs, guest musicians) and generally good soundboard quality despite some minor tonal issues lead to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Classic Super‑70 soundboard praised for clarity; however, several listeners note a tinny/harsh character that could benefit from EQ, especially before the Dark Star segment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set dominates with guest vocalists on Lovelight, a legendary Spanish Jam, and an extended Dark Star that showcases the relaxed yet inspired playing of the era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar is described as "on fire" with perfect tone, especially during Dark Star and Lovelight.
